blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix 2 scoops daily with 6-12 ounces of water or the beverage of your choice. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.
Note: 10 grams per 2 scoops is an average. Individual scooping technique may yield slightly less than or slightly more than 10 grams.
Collagen peptides may clump in cold liquids, so it is recommended to mix into room temperature, warm, or hot liquids and then add ice if a cold beverage is your preference.
Our Collagen Peptides can be added to hot coffee or tea, juice, water, soup, oatmeal, yogurts, and smoothies.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Notice: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.

Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
